name: Frey
title: Monastir Knights
description: A girl who calls herself the quartermaster of the Knights of the Duchy of Monastir. Deeply interested in making money, she is always coming up with new business ideas, though most end in failure.
introduction:
A girl who claims to be the quartermaster of the Monastir Knights.

Despite her rank, she can often be seen ordering around Charlotte and Carmen, the Grand Master and Deputy Master of the Monastir Knights, seeding plenty of rumors about her true identity among those who enjoy engaging in gossip.

Frey frequently talks about economics or new business ideas, but her <color=#2A80D8>common sense</color> often differs greatly from that of ordinary people.

Desiring both wealth and the power of the Star Savior, she accepted the invitation to the Journey without hesitation.

Increases self Max HP by 5%. Grants self 1 stack of Leap at the start of the turn. If self has max stacks of Leap after using Negotiation Failed, consumes all stacks of Leap after attacking, fills self action gauge by 30%, then restores all allies' HP. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP. When using Monastir's All-Out Support, if the target ally's HP is at 75% or below, fills all allies' action gauges by 9%.
